nodes.title: Reference Loading Notes
widgets_values:
Limiting the reference video's long edge can substantially reduce CLIP visual-encoding time, generation time, and VRAM usage. Adjust it according to the desired reference detail. QKV chunking reduces projection workspace pressure, so a larger reference resolution can still be tested when VRAM permits.

A long-edge limit of 0 keeps the source resolution.

For MiniMax H3 reference conditioning, keep the selected video range within the model's supported duration.

nodes.title: Export Notes
widgets_values:
The export helper can embed the workflow in the generated video. A video produced this way can later be dropped onto Prompt Load - Star7 to recover the prompt used for that run.

Messaging platforms may recompress the video and remove embedded workflow metadata. The Video only mode does not store a workflow.

Video + workflow PNG also creates a compact workflow image using the first video frame, which can serve as a visual workflow template card.

nodes.title: MiniMax H3 Sigma Shift and Chunking Notes
widgets_values:
Set Sigma Shift according to the LoRA. Common starting values are 6 / 3 for a 4-step LoRA and 12 / 3 for an 8-step LoRA. Bypass the Sigma Shift node to restore the default 12 / 3 setting.

CK generally prioritizes quality, while Sol and SLA trade approximation for higher throughput. In the recorded 1.0MP, 10-second, 4-step image-to-video case, complete-task times were 620.32 seconds for CK, 442.57 seconds for Sol All-INT8, and 325.51 seconds for SLA All-INT8.

Hybrid attention provides a quality/performance balance by using CK at protected sampling steps and sparse attention in the middle steps.

On the tested 22GB RTX 2080 Ti, QKV, RoPE, and MLP can start at 8192. Lower only the stage that needs additional VRAM headroom.

nodes.title: Model Loading
widgets_values:
RTX 20-series GPUs and other devices without efficient BF16 support should use MiniMax H3 Native FP16 Loader - Star7. See its GitHub page for the numerical-protection and quantization details. Newer architectures should use ComfyUI's standard UNET loader.

Model download:
https://pan.quark.cn/s/27f28ba550dc

Install missing nodes through ComfyUI Manager so they can be updated normally:

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-chunk-star7.git

https://github.com/star7code/minimax-h3-fp16-exact-star7.git

https://github.com/T8mars/comfyui-minimax-h3-audio-T8.git

nodes.title: LoRA Notes
widgets_values:
In current testing, larryvrh's minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600 produces a more natural appearance on real people. The original LoRA requires the author's dedicated loader; using an incompatible loader may cause blur or structural damage. The converted minimax_h3_turbo_v4_step600_comfyui_T8-convert version can be loaded with the standard LoRA loader.

Warnings produced by v4_step600 with a pruned base model usually refer to modules that exist in the full model but are absent from the pruned checkpoint. Verify the applied-key count and output quality for the selected base model.

# MiniMax H3 无参考图版本提示词

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, high-end 3D anime realism. An extreme close shot opens on a young woman leaning intensely toward the camera. She has lavender hair with loose strands falling across her face, soft freckles, focused amber-brown eyes, and black tactical outerwear. Behind her is a blurred urban street in daylight, with trees filtering soft natural light and a dark purple luminous mass pulsing ominously in the distance. She is already reaching toward the lens as the shot begins.

The camera holds close and shakes slightly with small amplitude, as if the viewer has just fallen backward onto the pavement. In the first second, her gloved hand moves into clearer focus as she reaches toward the viewer with urgency rather than aggression. She leans even closer, her brows tightening, and says in a low, breath-caught voice (S1): <d>[Chinese] 抓住我。</d>

Without cutting, the camera is pulled forward a small distance as if her hand has made contact. At around 00:02.500, the frame steadies slightly while strands of her lavender hair sway across her cheek. She turns her eyes briefly past the viewer’s shoulder toward the glowing disturbance in the background, then snaps her gaze back. Her breathing becomes more visible in her shoulders and parted lips.

At around 00:04.500, she braces, shifts one knee forward just out of frame, and exerts force to pull the viewer upright; the camera rises with her in one continuous motion. As the camera lifts, the background opens a little, revealing more of the empty street, drifting dust, and the ominous pulsing purple light behind her.

At around 00:06.000, she steps half a pace closer to shield the viewer, placing herself between the lens and the distant threat. Her expression softens for a beat without losing tension. She keeps one hand near the viewer as if making sure they are steady, then says with controlled urgency (S1): <d>[Chinese] 别回头，跟我走。</d>

In the final second, she begins to guide the viewer to move with her; the camera starts to pivot slightly to the right as if preparing to run beside her, while the purple glow flickers behind her shoulder and her lavender hair catches the changing light before the shot ends mid-motion.

overall_soundscape: A quiet outdoor city ambience runs underneath the shot, with distant wind through roadside trees and faint urban street hush. Close to the camera, her clothing shifts softly, her movement causes light scuffs against the ground, and her breathing is audible during the pull-up motion. A low unstable energy hum pulses from the distant purple disturbance near the end.

non_diegetic_music: Sparse low electronic pulses begin almost immediately, joined by restrained string textures at a slow tempo. The music grows slightly in intensity after she says the second line, then holds tension without reaching a full climax.
